reviews.review:
The developers are so actively involved in the community that they actively play both the base game and community maps with the community. They took on a ton of feedback in Early Access and have been working their asses off to make The Anacrusis the best possible game it can be. Props to Chet and the team at Stray Bombay, would recommend this to anyone who enjoys horde games like Left 4 Dead and Back 4 Blood.

Note: I have way more hours in this game, its just been in the mod tools

Poorman's Left 4 Dead clone that runs poorly, feels empty, and looks ugly.

But I also have a soft spot for sh*tty games, so what do I know.

Played it on the SteamDeck.

PS: I thought this game was new, but apparently it's been long dead even during early access. No wonder the PVP was empty.

The game has released into 1.0 and having played the earlier versions i'm rather disappointed with how the game has come out. Mechanically the game makes sense the game works; the gun-play and aliens are fine. But the problem i have is the general game otherwise then the straight forward game-play is mostly okay there are evident bugs and issues still prevalent. But playing it from early access to release, it plays about the same but with more fine tuning and smoothing.

You'd have more fun playing left 4 dead 2 compared to this but if you are looking for some fresh and new. I suggest getting it on a sale; the story and other elements of the game leave much to be desired such as story and the environments don't seem finished. Such as the same for back 4 blood, game-play was very refined and mechanically sound likewise more in-gauging then this game though what made that game un-fun and unplayable at the early releases isn't the same issue for this game. The game overall feels untactful when playing or lacking style or missing that phsazze or such.

It does have that feel of an early access game released a little too early there are many things that need more polish for sure. But if you can get this cheap less then 10 Euros i'd suggest grabbing it; otherwise just get a new left 4 dead copy for someone new to the game and have fun with them, it'd be much more enjoyable then this.

They need to address those issues and fix the lack of story & context for the players otherwise it just feels like i'm playing modded L4D2 And the objective is as simple as getting to the end. The game falls horribly short on explaining what is going on and what has happened, it also suffers from an issue of where campaigns aren't all made equally for amount of launching levels it has is depressingly small given the fact we are so many years after left 4 dead 2.

Back 4 blood easily had enough level content to satisfy me even if the story was absolutely bonkers and nonsense. It felt like i had a purpose from level to level with an objective even if the campaigns are shorter on some acts. But here the objective and the levels reasons for being there feels empty and hollow, that'd be a great way to describe the game. It has the essence of the left 4 dead 2 gameplay loop and nothing else, the rest feels like set dressing that is incredibly shallow.

It's good for a single playthru with a friend, but the game don't have any replayability potential or anything interesting. It feels really bland and missing any features. Sounds are very weak and the overall game feel is pretty empty. The weapons feel weak, have very slight sounds, no impact on enemies, enemies don't have blood, armor chunks, cloth pieces flying away, don't even stagger or flinch properly. 

It's just simply not rewarding shooting with your blasters like in star wars where there is a cool signature sound, bright red light of the laser, big impacts with sparks and burn marks on enemies, etc. One of the weapons have a literal bubble sound...

Game just simply needs more juice and less repetitive level design.
